summary: Range Capital Acquisition Corp., a blank-check company, filed an 8-K reporting the issuance of an unsecured promissory note for up to $1.5 million to an affiliate of its sponsor. The note bears no interest, is payable upon the company's initial business combination, and may be converted into units identical to IPO private placement units. This is a routine working capital facility, not a special situation event. No deal terms apply.
